advanced_metrics_registry.formula_description: Expected eFG shot-quality model based on shot location and play context; the fetched source does not disclose the full coefficient formula.
Possession-normalized offensive, defensive and net rating fields exposed by the PBP Stats totals/WOWY API; exact arithmetic is not stated in the fetched page.
API returns win_probability for league, margin, pregame win probability and seconds remaining inputs; the fetched endpoint returned 0.5076812505722046 for the sample inputs.
CF / (CF + CA), where Corsi counts shots, misses and blocked attempts against.
Corsi-style shot attempts excluding blocked shots.

Probability of each shot being a goal modeled with gradient boosting using distance, time since last event, shot type, speed from previous event, shot angle, prior-event location/type, manpower and shot location; team xG is the sum of shot probabilities.
Chance of not scoring in flurry yet × regular expected-goal value of shot.
xGoals of non-rebound shots + xGoals of expected rebounds.
NFL Next Gen Stats leaderboard metric; the fetched allowed page labels the measure but does not publish the full model formula.
NFL Next Gen Stats rushing leaderboard field; model formula is not disclosed in the fetched page.
NFL Next Gen Stats passing leaderboard field; model formula is not disclosed in the fetched page.
(called strikes + whiffs) / total pitches; the source defines whiffs and excludes foul balls.
Terminal-outcome probabilities produce predicted wOBA; change in expected wOBA is converted to run value and mapped to a 0–10 scale.
KDE of taken pitches and called strikes, Bayes probability of strike at each location, then contiguous 50% contour where probability crosses 50%.
Post-shot expected goals minus goals allowed, as labeled by FBref.
Provider-reported expected-goal total, described as a sum of shot probabilities; model details are not disclosed on the retrieved page.
